articles.title: US insists Strait of Hormuz is open as it exchanges strikes with Iran
articles.description: Iranian forces earlier said the Strait was closed and launched wide-ranging attacks at US allies and bases in the region.

articles.title: US senator and close Trump ally Lindsey Graham dies after 'brief and sudden illness'
articles.description: Donald Trump paid tribute to the 71-year-old South Carolina senator, calling him a "true American patriot" who will be "greatly missed".

articles.title: Son of man who died in Spanish wildfire disputes authorities' warnings claim
articles.description: The son of a Belgian man who died in a wildfire in Spain has disputed authorities' claims about the warnings issued.
